summary.text: Glen Vilhauer is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 5 who took office on January 14, 2025, and an accountant.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Vilhauer was born in Tripp, South Dakota, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Dakota in 1981.
His career experience includes working as an accountant.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Senate Appropriations Committee and is vice chair of the Senate Retirement Laws Committee.
